abilities.name: Rail Shot
abilities.description: Piercing shot along a line. Vex's bread and butter — punishes anyone standing still.

abilities.name: Frag Grenade
abilities.description: Lobbed grenade that detonates at the aimed area NEXT turn. Zone denial — forces the opponent to move where you want.

abilities.name: Combat Roll
abilities.description: Quick roll up to 4 squares. Dodges Blast-phase attacks aimed at your old position.

abilities.name: Overwatch Trap
abilities.description: FREE ACTION — costs no ability, so Vex still shoots this turn. Plants a hidden trap: 20 damage on entry and Reveals the victim for 2 turns.

ultimate.name: Lance of Dawn
ultimate.description: Map-length beam along a chosen lane. The lane is telegraphed to the opponent during their decision phase NEXT-turn pressure; landing it is a read. (100 energy)
